info.title: GenAI System Instructions
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.system_instructions attribute, describing the system instructions provided to a GenAI model.

SystemInstructions.description: Represents the system instructions provided to the model.
x-otel-deviation: Only text instructions are allowed, because this schema omits OTel's GenericSystemInstructionPart fallback.

TextPart.description: Represents text content sent to or received from the model.
x-otel-deviation: OTel allows arbitrary additional properties, while this definition does not.
The content field is optional because users may pass a text part without content.

type.description: The type of the content captured in this part.

content.description: Text content sent to or received from the model.
